sections.heading: Serving Scottsdale and the surrounding valley.
sections.body:
We cover all of Scottsdale and the surrounding area, including Old Town, McCormick Ranch, and North Scottsdale. For fifteen years we have kept pests out of valley homes the same way: inspect first, treat at the source, and leave a written field report so you can see the work.

Every technician is our own licensed employee, and if pests come back between visits, the same technician comes back free.
